title: Microcontroller Memory Architecture Overview
bullets: Microcontrollers combine CPU, memory, and I/O peripherals on a single chip
Memory types: ROM (program storage) and RAM (data storage)
Classification by memory architecture: Harvard (separate memory spaces) vs. Von Neumann (shared memory)
Memory capacity: Supports bit lengths beyond 64 bits
Common memory types: Embedded memory (integrated) vs. External memory (separate chips)
